WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
month_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        total_amount,
        LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_total,
        total_amount - LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as change
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT customer_id, AVG(change) as avg_monthly_change
FROM month_changes
WHERE change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)::DATE as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals
),
changes_only AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        monthly_total - prev_month_total as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_changes
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
customer_avg_change AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM changes_only
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    cac.avg_monthly_change
FROM customer_avg_change cac
JOIN customer c ON cac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
